Container.Name: daemonsight
Container.Overview: The DaemonSight hub: one page for every server running the DaemonSight collector. Each collector uploads to the hub over HTTPS; the hub never connects to them. Create the data folder and give it to uid 10001 first (chown 10001:10001). After the first start, set a password with: docker exec -it daemonsight daemonsight set-password. Settings are in config.toml in the data folder. Keep the port on your LAN; see docs/INSTALL.md, "Run a hub".

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The dashboard and the upload address. Keep it on your LAN, behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Config, password, session secret and database. Must be writable by uid 10001.
